ko: 믿음 소망 사랑을 내게 알게 하셨네
en: God so loved the world, He gave His only Son, That faith, hope, and love Were made known to me.

ko: 믿음 소망 사랑을 내게 알게 하셨네
en: God so loved the world, He gave His only Son, That faith, hope, and love Were made known to me.

ko: 그 사랑 세상을 더 품게 하사
en: That faith overcomes the world, That hope reigns over the world, That love embraces the world even more
My faith grows ever stronger, My hope grows ever greater, My love grows ever deeper within me
